response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS points_total, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(laps) NOT IN ('', '\N') THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM per_driver

assumptions.assumption: Missing laps are stored as NULL, an empty string, or '\N'; other nonmissing laps values are numeric.
